description: Record what the person said, in their own words, and the statements you propose from it. Each description names the topics it touched (question keys or grouping ids from make_my_selfie) and, for a life event, its category and life period. Each proposed statement names its origin and the key phrases carrying the knowledge, skill or ability; the KSA classifier and Dictionary connect each phrase, and unresolved or ambiguous phrases are returned for you to clarify with the person. Proposed statements are not affirmed.

channel.description: How the person said it; text when omitted

package.description: The package the last GoldSeam Selfie answer returned (goldribbon_package_v1 with its selfie_interview part). Keep it for the person and send it back whole; GoldSeam keeps no copy.

position.description: Where the conversation is: group, question_key, note

origin.description: The person's own description (from_descriptions: indexes into this call's descriptions, or description_ids) or a document passage (document { evidence_id, passage }). exploration { code } is context only, beside a description: occupational data alone never becomes a statement.

phrases.description: The key phrases to connect to the KSA Dictionary; the whole statement when omitted

text.description: The statement in plain words, as you will read it back

name: add_to_my_selfie

limits.description: What this answer could not do, each { code, statement }

package.description: The person's package with the interview; absent when the call could not use it

problem.description: When status is needs_attention: code, statement, what_to_do

status.description: What happened, or needs_attention with a problem

title: Add to My Selfie
